C1272.title: SSO Authentication Flaw Leading to Arbitrary User Login
C1272.summary: A March 2024 penetration-testing write-up described a mobile app sub-application that ignored the authorization credential issued by SSO and used a custom encrypted authentication interface. After reversing its frontend SM4, AES, and signature logic, the tester found that a correct phone number plus format-valid identity fields could obtain a token, enabling login as another user and access to order records.
